name: The Force
title: The Force
description: The mystical energy field created by all living things that binds the galaxy together, flowing through a light and a dark aspect and granting those attuned to it powers beyond ordinary reach.

name: Father
title: Keeper of the Balance
description: The eldest of the Mortis gods, a being of pure Force who held his light-sided Daughter and dark-sided Son in balance for millennia on the hidden world of Mortis, and who tested Anakin Skywalker as his prophesied successor before taking his own life to end his Son's threat.

name: Daughter
title: Embodiment of the Light Side
description: The Father's light-sided child, a serene embodiment of the Force's light able to heal wounds and take animal form, killed while shielding her father from her brother's blade.

name: Son
title: Embodiment of the Dark Side
description: The Father's dark-sided child, who sought to escape Mortis and spread the dark side across the galaxy, warring with his sister and losing his power and life after his father's sacrifice.

name: Qui-Gon Jinn
title: The First Voice
description: A Jedi Master who trained Obi-Wan Kenobi and discovered young Anakin Skywalker on Tatooine, and who, after his death at the hands of Darth Maul, became the first Jedi known to retain his identity as a voice within the Force.

name: Yoda
title: Grand Master of the Jedi Order
description: The nine-hundred-year-old Grand Master of the Jedi Order, renowned as one of the most powerful Jedi in history, who trained generations of Knights before his death on Dagobah and his continued existence as a Force spirit.

name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
title: The Negotiator
description: A Jedi Master trained by Qui-Gon Jinn who raised and mentored Anakin Skywalker, then watched over Anakin's son Luke in exile on Tatooine, allowing himself to be struck down aboard the first Death Star to be reborn as a Force spirit.

name: Anakin Skywalker
title: The Chosen One
description: A slave boy from Tatooine prophesied to bring balance to the Force, trained as a Jedi Knight before falling to the dark side as Darth Vader; redeemed at the moment of his death destroying Emperor Palpatine to save his son Luke.

name: Luke Skywalker
title: The Last Jedi
description: The son of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala, raised on Tatooine, who trained under Obi-Wan Kenobi and Yoda, redeemed his father from the dark side, and later gave his life projecting himself across the galaxy to save the Resistance.

name: Leia Organa
title: General of the Resistance
description: Princess of Alderaan and secret twin sister of Luke Skywalker, who leads the Rebel Alliance and later the Resistance against tyranny, spending the last of her strength in the Force to reach her son, Ben Solo.

name: Han Solo
title: Captain of the Millennium Falcon
description: A roguish smuggler and captain of the Millennium Falcon who joins the Rebellion for love of Leia Organa, later trying in vain to bring his son Ben back from the dark side before being struck down by him.

name: Chewbacca
title: The Wookiee
description: A towering Wookiee warrior from Kashyyyk and Han Solo's loyal co-pilot and closest friend aboard the Millennium Falcon, fighting for the Rebellion and later the Resistance across decades.

name: Lando Calrissian
title: Baron Administrator of Cloud City
description: A charming gambler who lost the Millennium Falcon to Han Solo in a game of sabacc, later administered Cloud City on Bespin, and, after betraying Han to save his city, redeemed himself leading the assault on the second Death Star.

name: R2-D2
title: The Astromech
description: A resourceful astromech droid who served Padmé Amidala, Anakin Skywalker, and Luke Skywalker across three generations, carrying the Death Star plans and Princess Leia's plea for help to Obi-Wan Kenobi.

name: C-3PO
title: The Protocol Droid
description: A fussy protocol droid fluent in millions of forms of communication, built by young Anakin Skywalker on Tatooine, who accompanies R2-D2 and the Skywalker family through generations of galactic conflict.

name: Padmé Amidala
title: Queen and Senator of Naboo
description: The elected Queen and later Senator of Naboo who secretly marries Anakin Skywalker, champions the Republic against the rising Empire, and dies giving birth to their twins, Luke and Leia.

name: Rey
title: The Scavenger of Jakku
description: An orphaned scavenger from Jakku, granddaughter of Emperor Palpatine, who discovers her powerful connection to the Force, trains under Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa, and defeats Palpatine to end the Sith, taking the Skywalker name as her own.

name: Finn
title: The Stormtrooper Who Ran
description: A First Order stormtrooper who defects after refusing to fire on civilians during the raid on the village of Tuanul on Jakku, escaping with Poe Dameron and joining Rey and the Resistance in the fight against the First Order.

name: Poe Dameron
title: Best Pilot in the Resistance
description: A daring Resistance pilot and squadron commander who rises to lead its remaining fleet, flying his X-wing with astromech BB-8 through some of the war's most desperate battles.

name: Boba Fett
title: The Bounty Hunter
description: An unaltered clone of the bounty hunter Jango Fett, raised as his son on Kamino, who becomes the galaxy's most feared bounty hunter, delivering Han Solo frozen in carbonite to Jabba the Hutt.

name: Jyn Erso
title: The Stardust Rebel
description: The daughter of Death Star architect Galen Erso, who leads a band of rebels to steal the battle station's plans at Scarif, sacrificing her life alongside Cassian Andor to secure the Empire's doom.

name: Cassian Andor
title: Rebel Intelligence Officer
description: A hardened Rebel intelligence officer who joins Jyn Erso's mission to steal the Death Star plans at Scarif, dying alongside her to transmit the plans to the fleet.

name: Mon Mothma
title: Leader of the Rebel Alliance
description: A former Imperial Senator who becomes a founding leader of the Rebel Alliance and later the first Chancellor of the New Republic, guiding the rebellion's political and military strategy.

name: Wedge Antilles
title: Commander of Rogue Squadron
description: A skilled Rebel pilot who survives the destruction of both Death Stars, founding Rogue Squadron alongside Luke Skywalker and fighting in nearly every major battle of the war.

name: Grand Moff Tarkin
title: Governor of the Outer Rim
description: A ruthless Imperial officer who oversees the construction of the first Death Star and orders the destruction of Alderaan to demonstrate its power, dying aboard the station when it is destroyed at Yavin.

name: Shmi Skywalker
title: Mother of the Chosen One
description: An enslaved woman on Tatooine who conceived and raised Anakin Skywalker alone, later freed and married to moisture farmer Cliegg Lars, whose death at the hands of Tusken Raiders drove Anakin a step toward the dark side.

name: Mace Windu
title: Master of the Jedi Order
description: A senior Jedi Master and member of the Jedi Council second in power only to Yoda, who distrusted Anakin Skywalker's training and was struck down by Darth Sidious when Anakin intervened to save the Sith Lord's life.

name: Darth Sidious
title: Dark Lord of the Sith
description: A Sith Lord who rose through Republic politics as Senator and Chancellor Palpatine, secretly orchestrating the Clone Wars to seize power as Galactic Emperor, before being destroyed by Darth Vader and later returning to be finally defeated by Rey on Exegol.

name: Darth Maul
title: Sith Apprentice
description: A Zabrak Sith Lord trained by Darth Sidious, who kills Qui-Gon Jinn in a duel on Naboo before being cut in half by Obi-Wan Kenobi, surviving in exile to build a criminal empire before his final death at Kenobi's hand decades later.

name: Count Dooku
title: Last of the Lost Twenty
description: A former Jedi Master who left the Order to become Darth Sidious's second Sith apprentice, leading the Separatist movement into the Clone Wars before being beheaded by Anakin Skywalker at Sidious's command.

name: Kylo Ren
title: Supreme Leader of the First Order
description: Born Ben Solo to Han Solo and Leia Organa, he was turned to the dark side by Snoke and the legacy of his grandfather Darth Vader, killing his own father before ultimately being redeemed by Rey and dying to restore her life.

name: Snoke
title: Supreme Leader of the First Order
description: A monstrous, scarred figure who secretly guided Kylo Ren to the dark side as Supreme Leader of the First Order, later revealed to be a genetically engineered strand-cast grown by Darth Sidious as a puppet ruler, and killed by his own apprentice.

name: Ahsoka Tano
title: Fulcrum
description: A Togruta Padawan trained by Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars, who leaves the Jedi Order after being falsely accused of treason and later fights the Empire as the Rebel intelligence operative known as Fulcrum.

name: Jabba the Hutt
title: Crime Lord of Tatooine
description: A massive, slug-like Hutt crime lord ruling the galaxy's underworld from his palace on Tatooine, who enslaves Princess Leia after capturing Han Solo, before being strangled by her at the Great Pit of Carkoon.

name: Sarlacc
title: The Pit of Carkoon
description: A tentacled, subterranean monster dwelling in the Great Pit of Carkoon on Tatooine, favored by Jabba the Hutt as a method of execution, said to digest its prey alive over a thousand years.

name: Rancor
title: Jabba's Pet Monster
description: A massive, clawed beast kept beneath Jabba the Hutt's throne room and unleashed upon prisoners for sport, slain by Luke Skywalker when he drops a gate on its skull.

name: Wampa
title: Beast of Hoth
description: A white-furred, carnivorous predator native to the ice world of Hoth, which captures and nearly kills Luke Skywalker before he escapes using his lightsaber and the Force.

name: Krayt Dragon
title: The Desert Serpent
description: An enormous, armored reptile native to the deserts of Tatooine, whose bones litter the wastes and whose fearsome howl was once imitated by Obi-Wan Kenobi to frighten off a band of Tusken Raiders.

name: Dianoga
title: The Trash Compactor Monster
description: A tentacled, single-eyed creature lurking in the waste disposal systems of the first Death Star, which drags Luke Skywalker underwater before retreating as the compactor walls close in.

name: Exogorth
title: The Space Slug
description: A colossal worm-like creature living inside asteroids, mistaken by Han Solo for a cave when the Millennium Falcon lands inside one to hide from the Empire's pursuit.

name: Mynocks
title: Silicon-based Parasites
description: Bat-like, silicon-based parasites that cling to starships and asteroids to feed on energy, infesting the Millennium Falcon while it hides inside an exogorth.

name: Tauntaun
title: Mount of Hoth
description: A reptomammalian creature native to Hoth, domesticated by the Rebel Alliance as mounts for patrols across the ice plains, one of which Han Solo cuts open to shelter Luke Skywalker from the cold.

name: Bantha
title: Beast of Burden
description: A massive, shaggy, horned herbivore native to Tatooine, domesticated by the Tusken Raiders and moisture farmers alike as a mount and pack animal.

name: Sando Aqua Monster
title: Terror of the Naboo Core
description: An immense apex predator dwelling in the planet-core seas of Naboo, large enough to devour the fearsome opee sea killer in a single bite as Qui-Gon Jinn, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Jar Jar Binks flee past in their submersible.

name: Acklay
title: Arena Beast of Geonosis
description: A crustacean-like predator with razor claws, unleashed in the Petranaki arena on Geonosis to execute Padmé Amidala, Anakin Skywalker, and Obi-Wan Kenobi before the Clone Wars begin.

name: Nexu
title: Arena Beast of Geonosis
description: A ferocious, saber-toothed feline predator, set loose alongside the acklay and reek in the Geonosis execution arena against Padmé, Anakin, and Obi-Wan.

name: Reek
title: Arena Beast of Geonosis
description: A massive, horned, thick-hided beast used in the Geonosis execution arena, ridden and tamed by Anakin Skywalker to help the captives escape during the Battle of Geonosis.

name: Tatooine
title: The Desert World
description: A harsh, twin-sunned desert planet in the Outer Rim, homeworld of the Skywalker family and the Tusken Raiders, and a haven for smugglers and moisture farmers under the rule of Jabba the Hutt.

name: Coruscant
title: Center of the Republic
description: An ecumenopolis covering an entire planet, capital of the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire, seat of the Jedi Temple and the Senate.

name: Naboo
title: Jewel of the Mid Rim
description: A serene, lake-covered world ruled by an elected monarchy, homeworld of Padmé Amidala, whose invasion by the Trade Federation set in motion the fall of the Republic.

name: Alderaan
title: World of Peace
description: A peaceful, mountainous world and homeworld of Princess Leia Organa, destroyed without warning by the first Death Star to demonstrate the superweapon's power.

name: Hoth
title: The Ice World
description: A frozen, remote planet that briefly hosts the Rebel Alliance's Echo Base, abandoned after the Empire discovers and besieges it in a devastating ground assault.

name: Dagobah
title: Swamp of the Hidden Master
description: A swampy, primeval world strong with the Force, where the exiled Master Yoda lives in hiding and trains Luke Skywalker in the ways of the Jedi.

name: Endor
title: The Forest Moon
description: A forested moon home to the small, tribal Ewoks, whose surprising aid helps the Rebel Alliance destroy the shield generator protecting the second Death Star.

name: Death Star
title: The Ultimate Weapon
description: A moon-sized Imperial battle station capable of destroying an entire planet with a single blast, used to obliterate Alderaan before being destroyed by Luke Skywalker at the Battle of Yavin.

name: Death Star II
title: The Second Battle Station
description: A vastly larger successor to the first Death Star, built in secret above the forest moon of Endor as a trap for the Rebel fleet, destroyed with Emperor Palpatine still aboard after Luke Skywalker carried his father's body to safety.

name: Yavin 4
title: The Rebel Stronghold
description: A jungle moon whose ancient Massassi temples shelter the Rebel Alliance's main base, from which Luke Skywalker launches the trench run that destroys the first Death Star.

name: Kamino
title: The Cloning World
description: A stormy ocean planet hidden from Republic archives, home to the cloners who create the Grand Army of the Republic from the template of bounty hunter Jango Fett.

name: Geonosis
title: Birthplace of the Clone Wars
description: A desert planet riddled with droid foundries and execution arenas, where the Separatist movement is unmasked and the first battle of the Clone Wars erupts.

name: Mustafar
title: The Volcanic World
description: A planet of rivers of molten lava and mining outposts, site of the duel in which Obi-Wan Kenobi defeats and maims Anakin Skywalker, leaving him to be rebuilt as Darth Vader.

name: Bespin
title: The Cloud City World
description: A gas giant whose floating Cloud City, administered by Lando Calrissian, becomes the site of Han Solo's betrayal into carbonite and Luke Skywalker's fateful duel with Darth Vader.

name: Jakku
title: The Scavenger's World
description: A desert planet littered with the wreckage of a decisive Imperial battle, where the orphaned Rey survives as a scavenger before being swept into the galaxy's renewed war.

name: Starkiller Base
title: The First Order's Superweapon
description: An ice planet hollowed out and converted by the First Order into a star-devouring superweapon capable of destroying entire systems, destroyed by the Resistance shortly after annihilating the Hosnian system.

name: Kashyyyk
title: Homeworld of the Wookiees
description: A vast forest planet of towering wroshyr trees, homeworld of Chewbacca and the Wookiees, defended alongside the Republic's clone army in one of the Clone Wars' final battles.

name: Exegol
title: The Hidden Sith World
description: A secret world in the Unknown Regions where the Sith plotted in hiding for a thousand years, and where Emperor Palpatine's fleet is unveiled before his final defeat by Rey.
